map.形如 ax²+bx+c=0 的方程，判别式 Δ=b²−4ac 决定根的性质。公式: For an equation of the form ax^2 + bx + c = 0, the discriminant delta = b^2 - 4ac decides the nature of the roots. The formula x = (-b +/- sqrt(delta))/(2a) automatically gives two real roots or a conjugate complex pair.
map.给出两个实根或复根: Gives two real roots or complex roots
map.显示求根公式与步骤: Shows the root formula and the steps
map.物理抛物线运动求落点: Finding the landing point in physical projectile motion
map.查看 Δ 与两个根: See delta and the two roots
map.Δ>0 两实根，Δ=0 一重根，Δ<0 两共轭复根: delta > 0 two real roots, delta = 0 one repeated root, delta < 0 two conjugate complex roots
map.复根含虚数单位 i: Complex roots carry the imaginary unit i
map.系数为 0 时提示非一元二次: When the coefficient is 0 it reports that the equation is not quadratic
map.没有实数解怎么办？: What If There Is No Real Solution?
map.Δ<0 时出现复根，工具会以 a±bi 形式给出。: When delta < 0 the roots are complex, and the tool returns them as a +/- bi.
map.x²−5x+6=0，Δ=25−24=1，根 x=2 与 x=3。: x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0, delta = 25 - 24 = 1, roots x = 2 and x = 3.
